GenoKit documentation¶

GenoKit is an open-source Python command-line toolkit connecting genome annotations with sequence extraction, oligonucleotide design and visualization. These pages describe the 1.0.0 source implementation. A published package may expose different options; check GenoKit --version and command help.

Start with Installation and Tutorial: annotation to sequence. The Worked example with a small genome page includes a small downloadable genome and annotation that can be used without human data. For a complete list of flags and defaults, see Command reference.
